title: SuperMega lean AI company workforce

dialectic.thesis: Reusable specialists let a small company cover product, engineering, growth, and risk.
dialectic.antithesis: Always-on swarms duplicate work, increase cost, and blur accountability.
dialectic.synthesis: Keep a dormant registry, activate at most four unique jobs from demand, and require evidence plus human gates.

manager_moves: Assign one outcome to one accountable team; reuse a specialist before adding a role.
Run only unique queued work inside signed budgets, leases, and daily limits.
Pause stale or low-value loops and measure accepted outcomes per work unit.

build_teams.name: Product
build_teams.mission: Convert real customer evidence into a prioritized product outcome.
build_teams.metric: Accepted outcomes backed by measured customer evidence.

build_teams.name: Engineering
build_teams.mission: Deliver secure bounded changes with independent verification and rollback evidence.
build_teams.metric: Verified changes with zero unauthorized consequential actions.

build_teams.name: Growth
build_teams.mission: Turn verified value into clear onboarding, qualification, and approved communication.
build_teams.metric: Qualified conversations generated from supportable claims.

build_teams.name: Finance / Risk
build_teams.mission: Control spend, data, access, exceptions, and approval integrity.
build_teams.metric: Zero unapproved spend, data exposure, or high-impact action.

delegated_pods.name: Product Evidence Pod
delegated_pods.mission: Prepare source-backed product and template decisions.

delegated_pods.name: Delivery Pod
delegated_pods.mission: Build and independently verify one bounded change.
delegated_pods.review_gate: Independent verification and owner release decision

delegated_pods.name: Growth Pod
delegated_pods.mission: Prepare qualification, onboarding, and communication from approved claims.

delegated_pods.name: Trust Pod
delegated_pods.mission: Inspect budgets, access, storage, releases, and incidents without self-approval.

instruction_packs.name: Agent Capacity Pack
instructions: Registry records are dormant until work is queued.
Keep at most twelve registered roles, four unique active assignments, and one in-flight run per job family.
Pause stale work and require evidence before review.
instruction_packs.done_when: No idle execution is running and each active job has one owner, budget, lease, and acceptance target.

instruction_packs.name: Security Pack
instructions: Deny public storage listing and broad tenant access.
Keep secrets server-side and use signed short-lived grants.
Block release on unresolved high-severity findings or missing rollback evidence.
instruction_packs.done_when: Identity, tenant isolation, storage privacy, secrets, logs, recovery, and rollback checks pass.

instruction_packs.name: Release and Observability Pack
instructions: Retain exact commit and environment identity.
Use bounded structured logs without secrets or raw customer payloads.
Scan early runtime errors after an owner-approved release and roll back on a failed gate.
instruction_packs.done_when: The candidate, smoke result, observability evidence, owner decision, and rollback path are attached.
